name: Polaris
source:
After a fatal crisis, you find yourself wandering in an unfamiliar world. You have only one goal: to survive by all means and find a way home. But is it really that simple? Unexpected encounters, imminent danger...you need to use all your wisdom to fight a way back.

And you are not alone. Can you find the support you need? Can you muster the courage to face the past? In the darkness where you can't perceive, the gears of fate are turning, and a greater conspiracy is surfacing. A price is always exacted for what fate bestows, and your choice is...?

[From [url=https://aere-ioke.itch.io/polaris]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一场致命危机过后，你发现自己流落到陌生的世界。你只有一个目标：无论如何都要活下去，找到回家的路。但事情真的有那么简单吗？意料之外的邂逅、迫在眉睫的危险……你必须倾尽智慧，杀出一条归途。

而你并非孤身一人。你能找到所需的支持吗？能鼓起勇气，面对自己的过去吗？在你无法察觉的黑暗中，命运的齿轮正在转动，更大的阴谋逐渐浮出水面。命运赐予的一切，总会索取代价，而你的选择是……？

[摘自[url=https://aere-ioke.itch.io/polaris]Itch.io[/url]]
